notes.title: Update Version 1.0
notes.notes:
The new version of the game is now available!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31101607/fbc2ee7ff3074f92f14c292c58f40f1d9248b9cb.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Version 0.7.0
notes.notes:
New Levels!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31101607/5bfdbf1c227e3b18d8ccb90f5068d2ec62263b3f.png[/img]

I have introduced three new levels into the game. They are all about transportation. You can use the servo part to construct arms, and by them you can grab the target object and bring it to the drop off location.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31101607/bc935773588c1b66e22220de0032e16bda08aac0.png[/img]

notes.title: Next Patch -> New Levels
notes.notes:
Time to Transport!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31101607/df4d1c83b7764b9644ad0a5098bf8d7c0026b79d.png[/img]
Most of the main features are completed so it is time to introduce some new missions into the game! 
The new levels will focus on the servo parts and on transportation.
So if you have completed all the previous levels, you will get  new challenges,
like picking up heavy items from planets and delivering them to orbit. Or transporting damaged satellites to their service station.

notes.title: Update Version 0.5.0
notes.notes:
Repair Packs!

      [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31101607/58894fc17e022345c5b4eff664ac675f165e3c9e.png[/img]

Now there are some repair packs hidden around the maps. You can use them to fix and rebuild your damaged ship. 
I introduced this because,I think it was just too easy to fail a level because of a minor damage to your ship. So now, if you lose a part of your ship, you can still repair it by pressing the new button on the right side or by pressing the enter key on your keyboard.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31101607/b8d144fb8029048a7a706bf8adf9343e528baa22.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Version 0.2.0
notes.notes:
New feature for the game.

Now every ship module has information and settings dialog.
You can activate them by right clicking on a module. This dialog shows information about the module, and also some modules let you assign keys for their activities. I also removed the old function key rotation from the game, because now you can use this functionality to set any key for the thrusters.

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.5
notes.notes:
This update mostly contains bugfixes.

1. Pressing escape on a dialog now close the dialog instead of opening the pause menu.
2. Highscore dialog background is now less transparent
3. Mouse scroll on dialogs now should work correctly
4. Cursor on dialogs now should remain the normal cursor
5. Object between the camera and the ship should become transparent now.

What's next?
Custom control keys for modules, so you can assign different weapons to different keys.

notes.title: Update Version 0.1.3
notes.notes:
This is just a small update containing many requested features. 
1. The leaderboard now is available from the ingame menu.
2. New Options menu now contains control settings.
3. Depth of Field now can be turned off from the options menu.
4. In general, I redesigned the options menu.

What's next?
Custom control keys for modules, so you can assign different weapons to different keys.
Object between the camera and ship will be transparent.
